github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use gitmojis to generate commit messages. Make sure to use the appropiate one for the type of change. Add a scope of the changes between parenthesis and don't start with uppercase. The subject format is '<emoji> (<scope>): <description lowercase>'. Example: '🔧 (vscode): add commit message instructions for github copilot'. When the change is non-trivial, include a commit body after a blank line with concise details about what changed, why it changed, and any relevant validation; omit the body for very small changes.
